prerequisites: None. Competences taught in the basic modules (topic-dependent) are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: have basic knowledge and skills in a selected sub-area of computer science
know practical concepts and applications in the selected sub-area of computer science
are able to apply scientific working methods when independently solving problems and to communicate the solution
have acquired competences preferably from the area of practical computer science

assessment_methods.method: Oral presentation of solution to at least two exercises
Written exam or oral exam (individual exam)

assessment_rules: To acquire credits, students must achieve at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercises and orally present the solution to at least two exercises. The grading is done with 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the B.Sc. Computer Science program. The examination performance is either a written exam or an oral individual exam.
